visualCharacteristics.purpose: Software update/download panel: copy with eyebrow, a version or state picker and a download button, optional image

contentPattern.structure: One row; cells by content: copy (eyebrow, heading, text) | list of versions/states (linked items are downloadable, plain items disable the button; optional paragraphs after the list give the price and button label) | image (optional)

usage: Software update and back-edition pages (30+ pages) and product promos with imagery.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for the same content pattern; background colour comes from section metadata Style (forest, green, bright-green, eggshell, neon, white, black).
